Name: Silk Trap
Effect: Shield Move. Reaction 4. Reduce 3 Damage the User would receive from a Damaging Move. If the Target used a Non-Ranged Physical Move against the User, Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
Description: The Pokémon weaves a thread of silk around specific parts of their body, both as an armor and as a trap to snare their enemies.
